articles.headline: Inside the disunited United States that shadows the WNBA

images.caption: "I'm here to play basketball," Cunningham said Friday night before scoring 13 points in Indiana's win over Portland.

images.name: Sophie Cunningham celebration [800x450]

images.name: Sophie Cunningham supporters [800x450]
images.caption: Cunningham drew supporters in Portland and Seattle. Another rally is reportedly scheduled for the Fever's game in Minnesota on Sunday.

articles.headline: Caitlin Clark and the most exciting warmup routine in sports
articles.description: Before games, Fever star Caitlin Clark might be the busiest athlete in sports.

images.name: Clark Lede
images.caption: Before the thing she's famous for, Caitlin Clark has a full day's work: a very public walk-in, an intense workout routine and, oh yeah, changing people's lives.
images.alt: Before the thing she's famous for, Caitlin Clark has a full day's work: a very public walk-in, an intense workout routine and, oh yeah, changing people's lives.

images.name: Clark Activation Combo 2
images.caption: In warmups, Clark replicates the physicality she experiences during games. "A lot of my work is usually with some sort of contact," Clark says. "It's certainly something that is a part of the way I have to play now."
images.credit: Top: Gabriella Ricciardi/ESPN Images. Bottom: Stephen Greathouse/NBAE via Getty Images

images.name: Clark Fans
images.caption: Clark struggles knowing she can't sign autographs for all of her fans each night. "I always try to take 10-15 minutes to sign on the way in," Clark says. "All of these people come here and spend a lot of time and money, and they're so excited."

images.name: Clark Red
images.caption: A brief rundown of items that get put in front of Clark: basketballs, her jersey, her basketball cards, posters and a surprising number of shoes. Even after games, fans mill around near the player driveway and hold out merch as Clark leaves for the night.

images.name: Clark Activation Combo
images.caption: Hundreds of fans record Clark's warmups, posting her makes and deleting any misses. When Clark stretches, she often wears a towel over her face to avoid any photos.
images.credit: Top: Brian Spurlock/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images. Bottom: Eakin Howard/Getty Images

images.name: Clark Walkoff
images.caption: "When you see little girls who look up to you and maybe want to be like you," Clark says, "it puts great perspective on the whole situation before the game starts."

images.name: How Caitlin Clark gets 'activated' before Fever games
images.caption: From the walk-in to the workout to the autographs, there might not be a busier athlete in sports than Fever star Caitlin Clark.
